semiconductor_relevance: High — Notion Systems specializes in inkjet printing systems for functional materials used in semiconductor components and printed circuit boards.
summary: Notion Systems GmbH develops advanced inkjet printing systems that are utilized in the production of electronic displays, printed circuit boards, and semiconductor components. Their n.jet platform is designed to scale digital printing processes from laboratory settings to industrial production, leveraging decades of expertise in precise inkjet technology.
capabilities: n.jet inkjet platform for electronic displays
inkjet systems for printed circuit boards

regional_presence.Europe: Notion Systems is based in Schwetzingen, Germany, and collaborates with sales and service organizations across Europe.
